corrections.text: The "What We Don't Know" section states that "neither the paper nor the model card discloses the specific hardware configuration ... used to measure the 2.42x throughput figure." This is incorrect: the Hugging Face model card states the default operating point was measured "BF16 on 2×H100 GPUs," and separately lists "Test Hardware: 2× NVIDIA A100 80GB or 2× NVIDIA H100 80GB (two-tower diffusion)." MarkTechPost independently reports "Evaluations use BF16 on 2×H100 GPUs." The hardware configuration is disclosed; only the absolute wall-clock time (e.g. tokens/sec or latency) is not given, just the 2.42x relative multiplier.
